summary: The proposed patch appears to be a correct fix for the UnboundLocalError issue, but it lacks a clear explanation for why the argument order matters and does not address the underlying cause.

issues.description: The patch may break existing/untested behavior due to the lack of understanding of why the argument order matters.
The patch uses a fragile approach by raising a NotImplementedError without addressing the underlying cause of the issue.
The patch does not include additional tests to ensure that the fix does not introduce any new issues.
